info.description: A chat server API with authentication and real-time messaging
info.title: Chat Server API

post.description: Authenticate user and get access token
Create a LiveKit room and notify other participants

get.description: Get all conversations for the authenticated user

post.description: Create or get existing direct conversation between two users

get.description: Check if direct conversation exists without creating it

post.description: Create a new group conversation with multiple participants
Send typing indicator to conversation members (rate limited to 5s)

get.description: Get full detail of a conversation including other-user info and presence (direct only)

post.description: Hide a conversation from the user's inbox. It will reappear when a new message arrives.

put.description: Mark all messages in a conversation as read for the authenticated user

post.description: Manually unhide a previously hidden conversation

get.description: Check the health status of the API and database

post.description: Send a message in a conversation
Send a message directly to a user (creates conversation if not exists)
Upload an image and create a message of type=image in one call (≤2MB jpeg/png/gif/webp)

get.description: Get messages from a conversation with pagination

parameters.description: Get messages before this message ID (timeuuid)
parameters.name: before

post.description: Toggle a reaction (LIKE/LOVE/HAHA/WOW/SAD/ANGRY) on a message. Idempotent per (user, message, type).

get.description: Get users blocked by the user (paginated)
Get pending friend requests received by the user (paginated)

post.description: Send a friend request to another user

get.description: Get friend requests sent by the user (paginated)

put.description: Accept or reject a friend request

delete.description: Remove a friendship with another user

post.description: Returns online status and last active time for the given user IDs (reads from Redis cache, no DB hit)
post.summary: Get presence status for multiple users

get.description: Search users by username or full name

post.description: Upload image to MinIO and get URL (does not update user profile)

get.description: Get public profile information of a user by ID, including online status and last active time

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and JWT token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
